releaseGate.rule: Python 3.12, Node.js 22, FFmpeg and Manim are hash-locked bundled Windows x64 runtimes for offline installation. HyperFrames CLI/Chrome bootstrap is separately reported and requires network only when no usable local copy is present. Credentials and tenant authorization remain first-run configuration.

policy.starterKitContains: metadata, source inputs, bundled Windows x64 runtimes, locked Python closures and explicit online-bootstrap metadata for HyperFrames CLI/browser.
policy.installerOwns: offline media, exact artifact hashes, Authenticode verification, package materialization, installation and rollback

pythonStrategy.reason: CPython 3.12 cp312 Windows x64 supports the hashed base and Manim wheel closures. Manim is isolated from the base application environment.
pythonStrategy.reuseRule: Reuse only a healthy CPython 3.12 win_amd64 interpreter whose cache tag is cpython-312. Python 3.11, 3.13, non-CPython and other architectures do not satisfy this contract.
pythonStrategy.fallback: If no exact ABI-compatible interpreter is healthy, install the locked private 3.12.10 artifact; never silently switch ABI.

artifacts.purpose: CPython runtime for local data, document, PDF, media and optional stateful Skills

integrity.sha256Source: SHA-256 of runtime/bundled/python-3.12.10-amd64.exe; downloaded from the official Python release URL.

authenticode.evidence: Get-AuthenticodeSignature returned Valid on the bundled installer.

install.path: Do not edit system PATH; record absolute python.exe and expose CODEX_PYTHON only in the private runtime record.

artifacts.healthCheck: & $env:CODEX_PYTHON -c "import platform,sys,sysconfig; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3,12); assert sys.implementation.cache_tag == 'cpython-312'; assert sysconfig.get_platform() == 'win-amd64'; assert platform.machine() in ('AMD64','x86_64')"
artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Use Windows installed-app uninstall for the same per-user version; upgrade only after a new exact media lock and health check. Never delete an unrelated Python installation.

artifacts.purpose: Complete offline Python wheelhouse for Skills that retain real Python functionality

source.indexPolicy: approved package index; record the index URL and timestamp in the private media manifest

integrity.sha256Source: Each of the 77 bundled wheels has an individual SHA-256 in runtime/bundled/python-wheelhouse-manifest.json and is verified before installation.

authenticode.evidence: per-wheel SHA-256, PyPI/index provenance and signed media manifest

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Install a new versioned per-user environment and switch the runtime pointer only after all wheel hashes and import checks pass; retain the old environment for rollback.

artifacts.purpose: Offline npm package cache for the official Feishu/Lark MCP

source.integrity: bundled package-lock.json preserves npm integrity for the 195-package closure

install.configCommand: Use the private wrapper command from config-fragments/feishu-official-stdio.template.toml; do not put App Secret in Codex TOML.

artifacts.offlineConstraint: The bundled ZIP contains the locked npm node_modules closure and package-lock.json. The installer extracts it without network access; Feishu still remains disabled until credentials and tenant permissions are supplied.

artifacts.purpose: Shared user-local Node runtime for HyperFrames CLI and optional Feishu MCP

integrity.sha256Source: Official Node.js v22.22.0 SHASUMS256.txt; checked against the bundled archive.

authenticode.evidence: Official SHASUMS256.txt plus exact archive hash; ZIP does not carry Authenticode signatures.

install.path: Shared runtime under the private Codex Agent Kit home; no system PATH mutation.

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Upgrade only with a newly pinned archive and matching checksum.

artifacts.purpose: Local video editing and HyperFrames render encoding/probing

integrity.sha256Source: Exact SHA-256 of the bundled BtbN release asset.
integrity.license: Archive is the LGPL shared build; retain its included license notices and see runtime/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

install.path: Private Codex Agent Kit runtime; wrappers ffmpeg.cmd, ffprobe.cmd and ffplay.cmd.

artifacts.uninstallUpgrade: Replace only through a new exact-hash runtime pack.

artifacts.purpose: Isolated Manim Community animation authoring/rendering environment

integrity.hashPolicy: Every wheel in the lock has SHA-256; installed offline with pip --require-hashes.

artifacts.healthCheck: CODEX_MANIM_PYTHON -c "import manim,av,manimpango; import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('manim') == '0.21.0'"
artifacts.optionalLatex: MiKTeX/LaTeX only for Tex/MathTex formulas; basic scenes do not require it.

artifacts.purpose: Local HyperFrames composition CLI, pinned to npm package 0.8.134

integrity.lock: runtime/bundled/hyperframes-package-lock.json; every npm package tarball has registry integrity in the lock.

install.path: runtime/hyperframes; exposes hyperframes.cmd only when installed
install.command: npm ci --prefix <private-hyperframes-runtime> using the bundled, hashed package.json/package-lock.json contract

artifacts.offlineConstraint: Without access to npm tarball URLs on first install, this capability is marked requires-network; later installs reuse the per-user lock marker and npm cache.

artifacts.purpose: Chrome browser required for HyperFrames local rendering

source.systemBrowser: Use a compatible locally installed Chrome when available

install.networkRequired: only when no usable system/cached Chrome is found

artifacts.offlineConstraint: Offline install can use a previously available supported browser; otherwise mark requires-network.
